statement: A reader built to close a false assurance on a framework construct recognised only the spelling the issue's reproduction used: a pytest hook adding pytest.mark.skip written in the call. The pytest documentation's own idiom binds the marker to a name first, and pytest also takes the marker by its name, so both skipped every test while A1 stayed verified under the rubric meant to fix it. Rules: build the fixtures from the framework's documented examples as well as the reproduction, and test each equivalent spelling the framework accepts, with a control beside each.
